# sfcompute_instance_template (Resource)

Manages an SF Compute instance template (created with `POST /preview/v2/instance_templates`; it cannot be updated in place, so any change replaces it).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sfcompute_instance_template" "worker" {
  name                 = "gpu-worker"
  image                = "sfc:image:sfcompute:public:ubuntu-24.04-cuda-13.2"
  cloud_init_user_data = base64encode(file("${path.module}/cloud-init.yaml"))
  tags = {
    role = "worker"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `image` (String) Machine image to use when starting instances with this template. Accepts name or ID.

### Optional

- `cloud_init_user_data` (String) Base64-encoded [cloud-init user data](https://cloudinit.readthedocs.io/en/latest/explanation/format/index.html). Maximum 64KB. Instances created by a generic or spot deployment inherit this data from the referenced template, so bootstrap steps such as worker registration can be configured here.
- `enable_public_ipv4` (Boolean) Assign a public IPv4 address to instances started with this template.
- `firewall` (String) Firewall to apply to instances started with this template. Accepts name or ID. Required when `enable_public_ipv4` is true, and rejected when it is false.
- `name` (String)
- `tags` (Map of String) Metadata tags to attach to this instance template. Instances launched from it don't inherit these tags.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace to create this template in. If omitted, the provider's `workspace` is used.

### Read-Only

- `cloud_init_user_data_used` (Boolean) Whether cloud-init user data is configured for this template.
- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `id` (String) Accepts the canonical prefix below; additional legacy prefixes are aliased for read compatibility. Writes always emit the canonical form.
- `owner` (String)
- `resource_path` (String) A resource path for a instance_template resource. Format: sfc:instance_template:<account>:<workspace>:<name>.
- `workspace_id` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sfcompute_instance_template.worker sfc:instance_template:acme:default:gpu-worker
```
